# affected consumer surface

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:affectedConsumerSurface`](gmeow-affectedConsumerSurface.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/affectedConsumerSurface>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The projection consumer surfaces that a myth tends to leak into — e.g. Wikipedia, public site, agent memory — so that a correction can be scoped to the surfaces that actually carry the bad claim. Reuses the [`gmeow:ProjectionContext`](../classes/gmeow-ProjectionContext.md) vocabulary.
